name: ChEMBL_search_similar_molecules
description: Search for molecules similar to a given SMILES, chembl_id, or compound or drug name, using the ChEMBL Web Services. Note: This tool is designed for small molecule compounds only. Biologics (antibodies, proteins, oligonucleotides, etc.) do not have SMILES structures and cannot be used for similarity search. For biologics similarity search, use BLAST_protein_search (requires amino acid sequence) or UniProt_search. For small molecules, use PubChem_search_compounds_by_similarity (requires SMILES input).

query.description: SMILES string, chembl_id, or compound or drug name. Note: Only small molecule compounds are supported. Biologics (antibodies, proteins, etc.) will return an error as they lack SMILES structures.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

oneOf.description: The failure envelope the tool returns instead of a result, e.g. when the optional epam.indigo dependency for structure similarity is absent.

name: ChEMBL_get_molecule
description: Get detailed information about a molecule by its ChEMBL ID. Returns molecule properties, structures, synonyms, and related data.

molecule_chembl_id.description: Alias for chembl_id. ChEMBL molecule ID, e.g., CHEMBL1229517.

data.description: Molecule data including structures, properties, synonyms

name: ChEMBL_search_molecules
description: Search molecules by name, ChEMBL ID, or other criteria. Supports filtering and pagination. Note: some text-based filters (especially `pref_name__contains`) may legitimately return zero results because `pref_name` coverage is incomplete and may not contain common drug names. For reliable retrieval, prefer ID-based filters like `molecule_chembl_id` or use `ChEMBL_get_molecule` when you already have a ChEMBL ID.

pref_name__contains.description: Filter by preferred name (contains). Note: `pref_name` coverage is incomplete in ChEMBL, so this can legitimately return zero results even for common names; prefer `molecule_chembl_id` for reliable retrieval.

query.description: Molecule name to search for. Alias for pref_name__contains.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Alias for limit.

fields.description: Optional list of ChEMBL molecule fields to include in each returned molecule object (projection). ToolUniverse maps this to ChEMBL's `only` query parameter (comma-separated). Supported fields: molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, molecule_type, max_phase, first_approval, black_box_warning, withdrawn_flag, molecule_structures, molecule_properties.

format.description: Response format (json, xml or yaml; default json)

items.description: Molecule objects returned by ChEMBL. When 'fields' is provided, each object will contain only the selected fields.

name: ChEMBL_get_molecule_targets
description: Get all unique targets associated with a molecule by ChEMBL ID. Returns targets that have activity data for the specified molecule (deduplicated from activity records).

molecule_chembl_id__exact.description: ChEMBL molecule ID (e.g., 'CHEMBL25' for aspirin). To find a molecule ID, use ChEMBL_search_molecules. Alias: molecule_chembl_id.

molecule_chembl_id.description: Alias for molecule_chembl_id__exact. ChEMBL molecule ID.

chembl_id.description: Alias for molecule_chembl_id__exact. Accepts the same name ChEMBL_get_molecule uses, so an ID can be carried straight from that call into this one.

limit.description: Maximum number of activity records to fetch for target deduplication (default 500).

name: ChEMBL_get_target
description: Get detailed information about a target (protein, gene, etc.) by its ChEMBL target ID. To find a target ID, use ChEMBL_search_targets with a target name or gene symbol.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID (e.g., 'CHEMBL2074'). To find a target ID, use ChEMBL_search_targets with a target name or gene symbol.

format.description: Response format (json, xml or yaml; default json)

data.description: Target information including name, organism, target type

name: ChEMBL_search_targets
description: Search targets by name, organism, target type, or other criteria. Use this tool to find target ChEMBL IDs needed for other tools.

target_type.description: Filter by target type (e.g., 'SINGLE PROTEIN', 'PROTEIN COMPLEX')

fields.description: Optional list of ChEMBL target fields to include in each returned target object (projection). ToolUniverse maps this to ChEMBL's `only` query parameter (comma-separated). Supported fields: target_chembl_id, pref_name, organism, target_type, target_components.

name: ChEMBL_get_target_assays
description: Get all assays associated with a target by ChEMBL target ID. To find a target ID, use ChEMBL_search_targets with a target name or gene symbol.

target_chembl_id__exact.description: ChEMBL target ID (e.g., 'CHEMBL2074'). To find a target ID, use ChEMBL_search_targets with a target name or gene symbol.

fields.description: Optional list of assay fields to include in each returned assay object (projection). Mapped to ChEMBL's `only` query parameter (comma-separated).

name: ChEMBL_get_target_activities
description: Get all activity data for a target by ChEMBL target ID. Returns bioactivity measurements (IC50, Ki, etc.) for molecules tested against this target. Note: activity values may be in different units (nM or uM) depending on the assay — check the 'standard_units' field in each result. To find a target ID, use ChEMBL_search_targets with a target name or gene symbol.

target_chembl_id__exact.description: ChEMBL target ID (e.g., 'CHEMBL2074'). To find a target ID, use ChEMBL_search_targets with a target name or gene symbol.

target_chembl_id.description: Alias for target_chembl_id__exact. ChEMBL target ID (e.g., CHEMBL213).

name: ChEMBL_get_assay
description: Get detailed information about an assay by its ChEMBL assay ID. To find an assay ID, use ChEMBL_search_assays or ChEMBL_get_target_assays.

format.description: Response format (json, xml or yaml; default json)

data.description: Assay information including description, assay type, target

name: ChEMBL_search_assays
description: Search assays by various criteria including assay type, target, organism. Use this tool to find assay ChEMBL IDs needed for other tools.

fields.description: Optional list of ChEMBL assay fields to include in each returned assay object (projection). ToolUniverse maps this to ChEMBL's `only` query parameter (comma-separated). Supported fields: assay_chembl_id, description, assay_type, confidence_score, target_chembl_id, assay_organism, bao_label.

name: ChEMBL_get_assay_activities
description: Get all activity data for an assay by ChEMBL assay ID. Returns bioactivity measurements from the specified assay. To find an assay ID, use ChEMBL_search_assays or ChEMBL_get_target_assays.

assay_chembl_id__exact.description: ChEMBL assay ID (e.g., 'CHEMBL615117'). To find an assay ID, use ChEMBL_search_assays or ChEMBL_get_target_assays.

name: ChEMBL_search_activities
description: Search activity data by molecule, target, assay, or activity values. Supports filtering by IC50, Ki, EC50, etc. Note: activity data is sparse and depends on curation; some specific filter combinations can legitimately return zero results. For reliable retrieval, prefer starting from a known target (`target_chembl_id`) or assay (`assay_chembl_id`). To find molecule or target IDs, use ChEMBL_search_molecules or ChEMBL_search_targets.

fields.description: Optional list of ChEMBL activity fields to include in each returned activity object (projection). ToolUniverse maps this to ChEMBL's `only` query parameter (comma-separated). Supported fields: activity_id, molecule_chembl_id, target_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units, pchembl_value, standard_relation, standard_flag.

standard_units.description: Unit of standard_value, null where ChEMBL recorded the activity without one. Null in 5 of 216 rows across five targets -- and in 0 of 150 rows for three of those five, so a sample from one target shows none of them however many pages it covers.

name: ChEMBL_get_activity
description: Get detailed information about a specific activity by its activity ID. Activity IDs are found in the results from ChEMBL_search_activities or ChEMBL_get_target_activities.

data.description: Activity data including molecule, target, assay, and activity values

name: ChEMBL_get_drug
description: Get detailed information about a drug by its ChEMBL drug ID. Includes approval status, indications, and mechanisms. To find a drug ID, use ChEMBL_search_drugs with a drug name.

format.description: Response format (json, xml or yaml; default json)

data.description: Drug information including approval status, indications, mechanisms

name: ChEMBL_search_drugs
description: Search drugs by name, approval status, or other criteria. Use the `query` parameter to search by drug name (e.g., {"query": "sotorasib"}). Use `max_phase` to filter by development phase.

query.description: Drug name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive). E.g., "sotorasib", "olaparib", "imatinib".

molecule_chembl_id.description: Filter by ChEMBL molecule ID (e.g., "CHEMBL1201580" for adalimumab).

name: ChEMBL_get_drug_mechanisms
description: Get mechanisms of action for a drug by ChEMBL drug ID or drug name. Accepts drug_chembl_id (e.g., 'CHEMBL1201581') or drug_name (e.g., 'trastuzumab') — drug_name triggers automatic ChEMBL ID lookup.

drug_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL drug/molecule ID (e.g., "CHEMBL1201580" for adalimumab, "CHEMBL4535757" for sotorasib).

drug_name.description: Drug name for automatic ChEMBL ID lookup (e.g., "trastuzumab", "lapatinib", "aspirin"). Case-insensitive. Triggers internal ChEMBL molecule search — use drug_chembl_id if you already know the ID.

molecule_chembl_id.description: Alias for drug_chembl_id. ChEMBL molecule ID (e.g., "CHEMBL25" for aspirin).

name: ChEMBL_search_mechanisms
description: Search mechanisms of action by drug or mechanism type. To find mechanisms for a target, use ChEMBL_search_activities with target_chembl_id to find drugs acting on it, then pass each drug_chembl_id here (the /mechanism.json endpoint does not support filtering by target). To find drug IDs, use ChEMBL_search_drugs or ChEMBL_search_molecules.

target_chembl_id.description: NOT SUPPORTED: the /mechanism.json endpoint ignores target-based filters, so passing this always returns an error. Use ChEMBL_search_activities with target_chembl_id to find drugs for a target, then query this tool by drug_chembl_id instead.

name: ChEMBL_search_binding_sites
description: Search binding sites by site name. ChEMBL's /binding_site resource filters only on site_id, site_name and site_components -- it cannot be filtered by target, so use ChEMBL_get_target or ChEMBL_search_targets for target-centric queries.

name: ChEMBL_get_molecule_image
description: Get molecular structure image (SVG or PNG format) for a molecule by ChEMBL ID. Returns the image URL and metadata.

chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID (e.g., 'CHEMBL25'). To find a molecule ID, use ChEMBL_search_molecules with a molecule name.

return_schema.description: Description of image data availability and access information

name: ChEMBL_search_substructure
description: Search molecules by substructure using SMILES. Returns molecules containing the specified substructure.

smiles.description: SMILES string representing the substructure to search for

name: ChEMBL_search_similarity
description: Search molecules similar to a given SMILES string using Tanimoto similarity. Returns molecules with similarity above the threshold.

smiles.description: SMILES string to search for similar molecules

threshold.description: Similarity threshold (0-100). Molecules with similarity >= threshold will be returned.

name: ChEMBL_get_compound_record
description: Get compound record information by ChEMBL compound record ID.

name: ChEMBL_get_compound_record_activities
description: Get all activities for a compound record by compound record ID. Returns bioactivity measurements for the specified compound record.

compound_record_id__exact.description: ChEMBL compound record ID. To find a compound record ID, use ChEMBL_get_compound_record or search activities.

name: ChEMBL_search_protein_classification
description: Browse ChEMBL's protein family classification by class ID. ChEMBL's /protein_classification resource filters only on its own class fields (protein_class_id, pref_name, short_name, class_level, parent_id, protein_class_desc, definition, sort_order) -- it cannot be filtered by target, so use ChEMBL_get_target and read its target_components for a specific target's classification.

name: ChEMBL_search_atc_classification
description: Search ATC (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical) classifications for drugs. To find a drug ID, use ChEMBL_search_drugs.

name: ChEMBL_search_documents
description: Search ChEMBL documents (publications) by various criteria.

document_chembl_id.description: Filter by document ChEMBL ID (e.g. 'CHEMBL1158643'). This is the identifier /document indexes on; the internal numeric document_id is not a filter ChEMBL accepts.

name: ChEMBL_search_cell_lines
description: Search cell lines used in ChEMBL assays.

cell_chembl_id.description: Filter by cell line ChEMBL ID

name: ChEMBL_search_tissue
description: Search tissues used in ChEMBL assays.

name: ChEMBL_search_compound_structural_alerts
description: Search compound structural alerts (toxicity warnings) by molecule or alert type.

alert__alert_name__icontains.description: Filter by alert name, case-insensitive substring (e.g. 'nitro'). The alert name lives on the related alert record, so it is reached through 'alert__'; a bare alert_name filter is not one ChEMBL accepts.
